seo_title: Mothercare SG Case Study: Reaching New Mothers | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read 4,049 posts and ads from 11 baby and parenting brands for Mothercare SG and found new mothers the most addressed type, identified 2,999 times.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Baby and maternity retail · Singapore
h1: Mothercare SG should inspire new mothers, then convert within their budget
lede: For Mothercare SG, SOMIN read 4,049 social posts and ads from 11 baby and parenting brands. New mothers were the most addressed type of mother, identified 2,999 times, so SOMIN mapped how brands reach them.
meta_line: A SOMIN custom study · Singapore · New mothers

challenge.title: New mothers face a lifestyle shock and a financial concern
challenge.body: This is especially true of a first child. The study compared how brands address new mothers in ads and in organic posts.

approach.title: 4,049 items sorted by mother type, persona and tension
points: Collected Instagram, Facebook and Ads Library content.
Classified items by mother type, from expectant mothers to empty nesters.
Detected ad and post personas, tensions and engagement ratios.
Added psychological, sociological and economic reasons.

findings_title: How 11 baby brands address new mothers

findings.title: Ads sell savings, posts sell family life
findings.body: The Family-Centered Savings Seeker led ads (131 items); the Family-Centered Wellness Advocate led posts (2,416 items, 80,573 engagements).

findings.title: Affordable quality dominates both channels
findings.body: Affordable and High-Quality Baby Products was the top tension in ads (90 items) and posts (1,120).

findings.title: Life beyond the product engages more
findings.body: Creating Safe and Comfortable Spaces for Babies drew the most post engagement, 39,657 from 797 posts. Parenthood challenges engage more than products.

delivered.title: Mothercare SG's new-mother map of personas and tensions
points: Types of mother: new mothers (2,999), mothers of infants (2,308) and of toddlers (1,823)
5 ad and 4 post personas by media and engagement
Reasons behind the tensions, to inspire creative directions

quote.text: When it comes to purchasing, it’s about providing the best you can within your budget.

outcome.title: Mothercare SG needs a funnel from aspiration to budget
outcome.body: Tap an aspirational mindset in awareness and consideration, then show how Mothercare SG fulfils it within a mother's means, with a purpose for each platform.

faq.q: Which brands were in the study?
faq.a: Baby Kingdom, Babyland, Cotton On Kids, First Few Years, Hatchery Cribs, Kiddy Palace, MothercareSG, Motherswork, Mummys Market, Pramfox and Pupsik.

faq.q: How do ads and posts differ for new mothers?
faq.a: Ads lean on savers and value seekers, posts on family-centric wellness advocates. Other personas earn higher engagement ratios, so the persona is multi-faceted.

faq.q: Are the reasons based on market data?
faq.a: No. They are textbook theories, which SOMIN usually checks against survey or BI data.
